name: effect-pill
title: Effect Pill
description: What one step of an agent's plan does, in one word and an icon: read, draft, change, send, remove or spend, hued by reach.

meta.whenToUse: Label a plan step or a pending action by its effect, in a PlanCard or a task list.
meta.whenNotToUse: A status (Badge), or a choice the person makes (ComposerChip).
